title: Terrapin Station
note: “Terrapin Station” debuted on February 26, 1977 and was last played on July 8, 1995. The song was performed 23 times in 1979.

representative_performances.label: The debut
representative_performances.why: First time out, opening the show five months before the studio album.

representative_performances.label: Hartford, the version of record
representative_performances.why: Released on its own as To Terrapin. The spring 1977 arrangement at full strength.

representative_performances.label: At the pyramids
representative_performances.why: Played at the foot of the Great Pyramid, coming out of Space.

representative_performances.label: Charlie Miller's pick
representative_performances.why: The 1979 show Charlie Miller singles out, and the one from the visitor's first question.

representative_performances.label: New Year's, inside Playin'
representative_performances.why: Tucked into the middle of Playing in the Band on New Year's Eve.

representative_performances.label: With Clarence Clemons
representative_performances.why: Clemons sits in on sax and the song stretches to almost 23 minutes.

representative_performances.label: The longest
representative_performances.why: Over 25 minutes in Boston, the longest Terrapin on record.

representative_performances.label: The last
representative_performances.why: The final Terrapin, at Soldier Field the night before the band's last show.
